title: 评测接口：榴莲

method_definitions.execution: 外层清洁基准+seed 0/1/2执行；原生/导出独立加载；交付哈希绑定，失败不删除。
method_definitions.delivery: 独立重新导入GLB比较世界尺度、几何/孔槽/姿态和可表达材质；不可表达的程序化节点单列，不自动烘焙位图。
method_definitions.state: Declared frames: no-bitmap audit only. Motion/rigidity/attachments and animated GLB equivalence remain unmeasured.
method_definitions.numeric: 按本题数值条款拟合实际平面/圆柱/截面；报告mm误差和容差；孔槽用边界+占用/连通检查，AABB仅作粗筛。
method_definitions.visible_geometry: 仅公开视角可见面并集做精确GT；统一整体配准、独立尺度门、逐图轮廓/可见面距离/法线；局部区域宏平均，未知背面仅检查合理性。
method_definitions.editable: 检查实际可编辑几何/部件组织及代码重建；对象名、变量名、顶点顺序不作为正确性真值。
method_definitions.assembly: 以几何匹配角色/对称置换；一次整体刚体对齐后测轴线、接触、规定间隙和实际实体穿透，禁止逐件配准。
method_definitions.image_pair: 从提交原生场景重渲染，再与本题公开参考图比较；前景轮廓、区域色差/结构和相机误差分报，进入主评分；提交PNG与重渲染须一致。全图SSIM不独立决定达标。
method_definitions.cost: 保留成功、失败、重试和反馈各轮时间/token/调用；未知token为null；成本与质量分列。

public_numeric_clauses: Use metres, Z up, and a maximum overall span of 1.000 m with 2% tolerance, excluding cameras and lights. This is a task scale convention, not a real-world measurement. Infer other proportions from the images.
Save the final static pose at frame 1 and export the same pose to scene.glb. Animation, exploded views and simulation are not required.
Render main.png at 1000 x 1000 pixels from a camera matching input/reference.png, using neutral studio lighting, Cycles, AgX and exposure 0. Retain the camera and lighting in scene.blend.
